PRECISION LANDING Mark a landing zone target on a flat surface. Land the drone in the center without tipping.

FLY THROUGH THE HOOP Set up a hoop and carefully navigate the drone through it.

NAVIGATE THE MAZE Create a maze using tape or other materials on the floor. Fly the drone through the maze.

DELIVER A PAYLOAD Design a mechanism that will allow the drone to carry a small lightweight object. Get creative!

Mark a target area. Use the drone to deliver the object to the target area.

SPEED RUN Set a starting point and a finish point. Fly from start to finish as quickly (and safely) as possible.

PICKUP MISSION Design a pick-up mechanism to attach to the drone. Get creative!

Set up a target area with small lightweight objects. Fly the drone to the target and pick up an object.

AVOID THE NO-FLY ZONE Set a starting point and a finish point. Mark some “no-fly” zones or obstacles within the flight area. Fly from start to finish while avoiding the no-fly zones or obstacles.

LEAPFROG Set up some objects on the floor, evenly spaced apart. “Hop” the drone over the objects one at a time, landing between each.

FLY IN A SQUARE Fly the drone in a square pattern, starting and ending at the same point.

MAXIMUM AIR TIME Keep the drone in flight as long as possible. How long can you fly before the battery is low enough that it needs to land?

You’ll need a timer!
